She has visible arm tattoos and wears a cross pendant, a leopard-print fitted sleeveless top, and matching tailored shorts with subtle black trim. Arrange her hair naturally across the felt, keep one arm relaxed at her side, and use the other hand for a playful natural gesture toward the lens. Scatter red and yellow billiard balls around her and place a pool cue along one side of the table. Use moody cinematic lighting with warm highlights and soft shadows, sharp billiard colors, natural skin and fabric texture, and a bold non-sexualized tattoo-fashion mood. No smoking, text, logo, or watermark.
